periodSummaryMethod: Time is estimated between saved checks in the same uninterrupted run, for at most the earlier check's recorded interval. Time after the last check is left unknown until another check arrives.
periodSummaryDenominator: Availability = up time / (up time + down time). Pending retries, maintenance and time without data are excluded. Always read it together with period coverage.
periodSummaryRetention: Only retained history is used. Routine history is normally reduced after 24 hours, so older periods may have much less data. Removed records are not reconstructed from aggregate statistics.
periodSummaryTimeTable: Accounted time and saved checks by state
periodSummaryCheckCount: Saved checks in period: {total}. Unrecognized states: {unknown}.
periodSummaryGapHelp: Gaps, pauses, restarts, deleted history and unrecognized states never count as uptime. The number of missed runs and the cause of a gap cannot be recovered reliably.
periodSummaryLegacy: Some checks have no saved schedule. Their states and response times are included, but their time remains unknown. New schedule information is recorded after this update; old settings are not guessed.
periodSummaryEmpty: No saved checks fall inside this period.
periodSummaryTooLarge: The summary exceeds 50,000 saved checks. Choose a shorter period; no partial summary was created.
periodSummaryBusy: Another summary is running for your account. Please wait and try again.
periodSummaryFailed: Could not calculate the summary. Check your connection and sign-in, then try again.
periodSummaryTimeout: The summary did not finish in time. Try a shorter period.

workspaceIssueUnknown: No fresh observation. Check the connection and the last check time.
workspaceIssuePending: Confirming the result before declaring a failure.
workspaceIssue404: Page not found (404). Check the address and application deployment.
workspaceIssueAccess: The server refused access. Check the expected authorization.
workspaceIssueRate: The server is limiting requests. Check the polling frequency.
workspaceIssueServer: The server returned an error. Check the application and its dependencies.
workspaceIssueDNS: The host address could not be resolved. Check DNS settings.
workspaceIssueTLS: A secure connection could not be verified. Check the certificate.
workspaceIssueTimeout: The service did not reply in time. Check its connection and load.
workspaceIssueUnreachable: The check failed. Open the saved evidence to investigate.

stage2FirstEvidence: First error in this retained sequence
stage2ConfirmedFailure: First confirmed failure in this sequence
stage2HistoryLimited: The retained history has a gap or lacks the preceding successful check. Exact incident start and duration cannot be established.
stage2GuidanceHonesty: These are suggestions based on saved observations. No settings or services have been changed automatically.
stage2ActionAddress: Check that the monitored page address is still correct.
stage2ActionDeployment: Check whether the application is deployed and this page exists. A 404 must not be accepted as success.
stage2ActionAuthorization: Check the access method and the account used for this check.
stage2ActionOwner: Pass the saved check time and symptoms to the service administrator.
stage2ActionRate: Review polling frequency and the service request limits.
stage2ActionDNS: Check domain records and the name server response.
stage2ActionTLS: Check certificate expiry, hostname and certificate chain. Keep identity verification enabled.
stage2ActionLoad: Check application load and dependent services.
stage2ActionConnection: Check the connection between the monitoring server and the service.
stage2ActionSpeed: Compare the measured response with the agreed response-time limit.
stage2ActionMonitoring: Check whether monitoring is connected and the check is running.
stage2ActionLogs: Open the application logs for the saved check time.
stage2EvidenceHonesty: Only retained observations are shown. Time between them is not automatically counted as working or failed.
stage2NoAssignedChannels: No notification channels are assigned to this service.
stage2DeliveryHonesty: Accepted means the sending service accepted the message. Only your explicit confirmation records receipt. Older channels keep their existing sending behavior; their attempts are not listed here.
stage2DeliveryError_rate: The service limited requests. Check the sending status and scheduled time before trying again.
stage2DeliveryError_unavailable: Could not connect or the service temporarily rejected sending.
stage2DeliveryError_auth: The service refused access. Check the account or bot token.
stage2DeliveryError_tls: Secure identity verification failed. Check the sending server certificate.
stage2DeliveryError_recipient: The service rejected the recipient or message. Check channel settings.
stage2DeliveryError_unknown: Delivery may have happened. Check the destination before requesting another test.
stage2DeliveryError_interrupted: Sending was interrupted. Automatic repeat is disabled to avoid duplicates.
stage2DeliveryError_changed: Settings or check state changed before sending.
stage2SecretHelp: Leave empty when editing to keep the saved password. Passwords are not shown again.
stage2TelegramChat: Recipient chat ID or channel username
stage2TelegramInstructions: Create your bot with BotFather, send it /start, and enter the destination chat ID. For a channel, add the bot with permission to post.
stage2SecureChannels: This setup uses certificate-verified mail or the official Telegram service. Saving does not send a test automatically.
stage2AlertSelection: Which services should use this channel?

stage2NoSelection: No existing checks are selected. Only a manual channel test can be sent.
stage2DefaultForNew: Enable this channel for new checks

stage2TestNotSent: Settings saved. No test has been sent.

stage2SavedNeedsTest: Saved; receipt has not been confirmed for these settings
stage2InvalidRequest: Check the selected service and form values.
stage2ChannelInvalid: Check the channel name, server, port, recipient and access details.

stage2ChannelNotFound: This channel is not available to your account.
stage2QueueFull: Too many messages are waiting. Check delivery before adding more.
stage2TestCooldown: Wait at least 30 seconds between channel tests.
stage2ConfirmationInvalid: Only a submitted test of the current saved settings can be confirmed.
stage2DeliveryUnavailable: Channel information is temporarily unavailable. Check the connection and try again.

stage2ResponseLimitInvalid: Set an HTTP response limit from 1 to 3,600,000 milliseconds, or leave it empty.
stage2WhatToCheck: What would you like to monitor?
stage2PresetHelp: Choose a starting point, then enter the target and save. No check is created until you save.
stage2PresetSiteHelp: Page availability and expected response code.
stage2PresetSpeedHelp: Detect replies slower than the configured limit.

stage2PresetPortHelp: Check whether a service accepts a connection.

projectAIKeyHelp: The key is encrypted on the server and is not shown again. Saving does not send a paid request.
projectAIDataConsent: What may be sent for analysis
projectAINoSecrets: Passwords, tokens, signed URLs, raw page responses and raw logs are not sent. You review the exact evidence before requesting a diagnosis.

projectAIPlanLimitHonesty: ChatGPT plan usage does not support an API output-token cap. Plan and credit limits are managed in ChatGPT.
projectAISubscriptionHelp: Sign in to your own ChatGPT account and grant access. A saved login is not a completed model test.
projectAIRemoteHelp: For a remote server, complete sign-in on the computer running your browser. The one-use helper transfers the selected connection securely to this server.
projectAIRunHelper: Run the helper with Node on your computer and open the displayed official sign-in address.
projectAINoAccountBorrow: Only the account you explicitly authorize is used. Existing computer accounts are not read. No paid fallback API is used.
projectAIPreviewHelp: Review the saved facts. Analysis starts only after your explicit action.
projectAIExplicitSend: Send only the displayed facts under this project’s AI settings and limits.
projectAINoHistory: No requests have been made yet.
projectAICostUnknown: The provider did not report a monetary cost.
projectAIUncertainCost: No request will be repeated automatically. A started request may have consumed the provider’s allowance even if its result is unknown.
projectAISavedNoCall: Settings saved. No model request was sent.
projectAIRevocationUnknown: Local access was replaced or removed, but remote revocation was not confirmed. Disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings if needed.
projectAIModelsLoaded: Available models loaded. Select one, save and run the connection test.
projectAISignInPending: Complete the official sign-in. Then load the models, choose one and run a separate connection test.
projectAIError_auth: Access is invalid or expired. The administrator needs to reconnect this account.
projectAIError_limit: The provider rejected the request because of a limit. No fallback API was used.
projectAIError_timeout: The waiting time expired. The request is not repeated automatically.
projectAIError_unavailable: The provider response could not be confirmed.
projectAIError_response: The provider returned an unusable explanation. It is not shown as a diagnosis.
projectAIError_incomplete: The stream ended without a completed response.
projectAIError_changed: Access, project or AI settings changed. The old result is not issued.
projectAIError_interrupted: The program restarted during a request. It is not sent again automatically.
projectAIError_cancelled: The request was stopped or its time limit was reached.
projectReportHonesty: The summary uses retained observations. Missed time is unknown, not successful uptime. Maximum range: 31 days.
projectAccessDenied: You no longer have permission for this project or action.
projectLimit: The project’s object limit has been reached.
projectChanged: The saved data changed. Refresh and try again.
projectPersonalOwner: The owner of a personal workspace keeps administrator access.
projectLastAdmin: At least one administrator must remain in the project.
projectPasswordInvalid: Choose a password of at least 12 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.
projectUsernameUsed: This username already exists. Sign in with that account or choose another name.
projectInviteInvalid: The invitation is invalid, expired, revoked or already used.
projectKeyMissing: The protected key store is unavailable. Restore its protected key backup; existing credentials have not been replaced.
projectAINotConnected: The administrator must save an AI connection and select a model first.
premiumAutoChecksHelp: Select working checks. You can exclude examples and inactive projects. New checks are not added to this selection automatically.
premiumAutoNoChecks: Add a check to this project first.
projectAIWorkerConnected: Connected to the separate AI service
projectAIWorkerUnavailable: The AI service is unavailable. Account settings are preserved.
projectAIKeyRequired: Enter an API key for this project.
projectAIDailyLimit: This project’s daily request limit has been reached.
projectAIBusy: This project already has a pending AI request. Wait for it or cancel it.
projectAINeedProbe: A completed connection test is required before diagnosis.
projectAIEvidenceChanged: The saved facts changed. Review the new evidence before sending.
projectSignInInvalid: The sign-in is invalid or expired. Start a new connection.
projectSignInNeedsHelper: Use the local sign-in helper for this remote server.
projectSignInDeclined: Sign-in or plan permission was declined.
projectAuthRequired: Projects and roles require sign-in. Enable authentication in installation settings.
projectBusy: Another action is being processed. Try again shortly.
projectOperationFailed: The action could not be completed. Refresh and try again.
projectUsePersonalEditor: Use the original owner interface to edit advanced personal checks.
workspaceIssueProjectTarget: This target is outside the project’s approved network access.
projectAudit_aiJobFailed: AI request ended without a completed result
projectJSONPathHelp: A simple field path, for example services[0].state. Expressions and functions are not accepted.
projectInstallationAdminHelp: Earlier owner accounts retain installation-wide settings. Invite a new separate account to grant only project access.
projectMyAccountHelp: Your own password and two-step sign-in. Project permissions are managed separately by its administrator.
projectPasswordsMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
projectTwoFAVerifyFirst: Prepare two-step sign-in and verify a fresh code before enabling it.
projectRecoveryIntro: AI proposes a plan. The owner approves the change. New observations verify the outcome.
projectRecoverySetupHelp: Application control is not configured. The server owner must first select the application, its permitted configuration file and an approved version. Monitoring continues.
projectRecoveryScenario: Available action: restore one application’s previously approved configuration.
projectRecoveryRisks: The application may briefly stop responding. The approved configuration may not resolve this incident. On failure, the previous configuration is restored. If an external change is detected, restoration pauses for owner review.
projectRecoveryAIConsent: Only the displayed facts and permitted action metadata will be sent. File contents, paths and passwords are excluded. This request uses your AI allowance.
projectRecoveryPlanHelp: The plan is ready. Application settings have not changed yet.
projectRecoverySnapshotFirst: Save and verify a protected recovery point.
projectRecoveryReplaceOne: Replace only the permitted file with its approved version.
projectRecoveryVerifyTwo: Wait for two new successful regular monitoring checks.
projectRecoveryRollbackOnFailure: On failure, cancellation or missing verification, restore the previous configuration.
projectRecoveryExpires: Approve before {time}; a new plan is required after expiry.
projectRecoverySnapshotSaved: Recovery point saved: {time}. No deletion deadline is set.
projectRecoveryWaiting: The change was applied. Waiting for new checks; recovery is not confirmed yet.
projectRecoveryVerified: New successful checks after applying the change: {count}. This does not establish the root cause.
projectRecoveryRollbackHealthy: The previous configuration is restored. The latest new check succeeded.
projectRecoveryRollbackUnhealthy: The previous configuration is restored. The service is still unhealthy; this is not a successful fix.
projectRecoveryOwnerConsentHelp: This decision applies only to this application and the displayed change. The project owner confirms using their current password.
projectRecoveryConsent: I approve this one change and automatic restoration of the previous configuration on failure or cancellation.
projectRecoveryReturnConsent: I approve restoring this change’s saved previous configuration. The service may become unhealthy again.
projectRecoveryRetryConsent: I reviewed the failure and allow a new proposal. The three-attempt limit per 24 hours and five-minute cooldown remain.
projectRecoveryPolicy: Application control rules are unavailable or unsafe. Recovery is blocked; contact the server owner.
projectRecoveryBaseline: The approved configuration failed validation. The change is blocked.
projectRecoveryNoChange: The current configuration already matches the approved version. This action would make no change.
projectRecoveryDrift: The configuration or approved target changed. Unrelated data was not overwritten. Check the application manually.
projectRecoveryService: The selected application state could not be confirmed. Check it before another attempt.
projectRecoveryOwnerOnly: Only the project owner with administrator rights can approve, cancel or restore changes.
projectRecoveryRateLimit: Too many attempts. Changes are limited to three attempts per 24 hours with a five-minute cooldown; password attempts are also limited.
projectRecoveryPassword: The current password was not verified. The change is not authorized.
projectRecoveryNotConfigured: No permitted application control is configured for this check.
projectRecoveryFailureRequired: A fresh confirmed failure from an active check is required. Changes are blocked during pause, maintenance or missing observations.
projectRecoveryStale: The plan or its evidence is stale. Review the current state and prepare a new plan.
projectRecoveryNoRecommendation: AI did not justify the available recovery action. No change is made.
projectRecoveryBlocked: Another attempt is blocked after a failure or an unfinished action. The owner must review the outcome first.
projectRecoveryExecutor: Change execution is unavailable. Check configuration or another running process; monitoring continues.
projectRecoveryCancelled: The change was cancelled. If it had already begun, the previous configuration is being restored.
projectRecoveryInterrupted: Execution was interrupted. The forward change is not automatically repeated; restoration is verified separately.
projectRecoveryNoObservations: Not enough new checks arrived within the time limit. Success is not confirmed.
projectRecoveryBackup: The recovery point is unavailable or invalid. A new change is blocked.
projectRecoveryUnavailable: The operation did not complete. Review the history and application state; it is not automatically retried.
projectRecoveryRepeatedFailure: Further changes are blocked after an unsuccessful attempt until the owner reviews it.
workspaceManagementHelp: Select checks to pause, resume or delete them. Drag checks to change their order or group. Status and tag filters remain available here.
premiumChartDescription: Saved response measurements: {count}. Missing observations are not joined.
premiumChartHonesty: The line uses measured response times only. Grey areas are gaps; red dots below the plot are failures without a measurement.
premiumPersonalAIHelp: Understand incidents and review changes before approval.
premiumCheckAlertsHelp: Email and Telegram: setup, test messages and delivery results.
premiumAIIncidentHelp: Analysis uses the data approved by your administrator. Possible causes are kept separate from facts.
premiumAINoExplanation: There is no explanation for this check yet. Preview the evidence before sending it.
premiumAINeedsConnection: Connect your own AI with a ChatGPT subscription or API in project settings.
premiumAutoNeedsConsent: Updated settings or permissions need renewed consent
premiumAutoHelp: After two consecutive confirmed failures, AI analyzes the check once. Two fresh successful checks rearm it for the next incident.
premiumAutoLimits: A separate daily cap and the project budget both apply. Restarts never replay a claimed request. This authorizes analysis only; recovery still requires separate owner approval.
premiumAutoEnable: Start diagnosis after a confirmed failure
premiumAutoConsent: I authorize sending future observations under the current AI data-sharing settings
projectAIAutomationDuplicate: This incident was already submitted for analysis
projectAudit_aiAutomaticDiagnosisQueued: Confirmed incident automatically submitted for analysis
premiumWitness_missing: No fresh confirmation from the second server
premiumWitness_not_configured: A second server is not connected to this installation yet
premiumWitnessChannels: Outage notification channels are configured on the independent node.
premiumWitnessNoChannels: Full-outage alerts are not configured yet. Email and Telegram recipients are required.
premiumWitnessHonesty: Three failed probes confirm unavailability; two successful probes confirm recovery. Configuring a channel does not prove message receipt.
premiumTrackingHelp: See how services depend on each other and spot growing response times.
premiumTrackingTruncated: The first 200 checks are shown. Event-triggered diagnosis does not run automatically for a project of this size.
premiumTrend_increased: Response times increased — investigate the cause
premiumTrendValues: Previous 10 measurements: {before}. Latest 5: {recent}. Values are medians.
premiumTrendHonesty: Uses 15 consecutive successful checks without gaps. Increases require at least 50% and 100 ms. This is an advisory; failure limits are configured separately.
premiumDependencyHonesty: Dependencies help identify a shared cause. They do not change check results or suppress alerts.
projectDependencyCycle: This dependency creates a cycle. Choose another service.
premiumRecoveryReturning: Restoring the previous data. Restoring a file alone does not prove service health; verification is shown separately.
premiumRecoveryHonesty: Only completed steps are marked. Waiting or missing observations never count as successful verification.
stage2DeliveryError_target: The mail server is on an internal network. An administrator must approve its address in project settings. Sending did not start.
siteWorkConfirmed: A server signal confirms planned work. An HTTP error alone never establishes its cause.
siteWorkOverdue: Work has exceeded its deadline. Normal checks have resumed; failures are no longer treated as maintenance.
siteWorkOverdueHonesty: The server still reports work, but its deadline has passed. Availability, failures and missing data now follow ordinary checks.
siteWorkChecksHonesty: This period is recorded separately as maintenance. Site availability is not confirmed during it. Normal checks resume after the deadline or if the signal is lost.
siteWorkNotice_finished_pending: Work finished — awaiting a repeated site check
siteWorkNotice_overdue_pending: Work deadline exceeded — awaiting a repeated site check
siteWorkNotice_signal_lost_pending: Work signal lost — awaiting a repeated site check
